question: What did the people promise if neighboring peoples brought goods or grain to sell on the Sabbath?
options: To buy only half of it
To sell it again the next day
To give it to the Levites
Not to buy from them on the Sabbath or any holy day
explanation: They promised that when the neighboring peoples brought merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, they would not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day.
